name: Advanced Dervish Path [Psionic]
body:
You seem to float between enemies, a blur of destruction.

Prerequisites: Dex 15, Double Slice, Two-Weapon Fighting, Dervish path class feature, manifester level 10th, base attack bonus +6

Benefit: When using the Dervish trance, the competence bonus applies to your damage as well as your attack rolls. In addition, you can use the Dervish maneuver even if you moved before your attack and you have no limit of how many 5-foot steps you can take while using the Dervish maneuver, as long as you make at least one attack before each 5-foot step. The maximum distance you can move in this round is that of a double move.
